sql: WITH t AS (SELECT DISTINCT market_ticker FROM live_orders WHERE strategy='Alimm1'), f AS (SELECT f.* FROM fills f JOIN t USING (market_ticker)), p AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (market_ticker) market_ticker, quantity, realized_pnl FROM positions JOIN t USING (market_ticker) ORDER BY market_ticker, captured_at DESC) SELECT 'fills_all' k, count(*)::text a, round(sum(price*quantity)/100.0,2)::text b FROM f UNION ALL SELECT 'fills_since_cap', count(*)::text, round(coalesce(sum(price*quantity),0)/100.0,2)::text FROM f WHERE filled_at > '2026-09-29 11:40' UNION ALL SELECT 'realized_pnl', count(*)::text, round(sum(realized_pnl)::numeric,2)::text FROM p UNION ALL SELECT 'pairs_placed_since_cap', (count(*)/2)::text, '' FROM live_orders WHERE strategy='Alimm1' AND created_at > '2026-09-29 11:40' AND kalshi_order_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'reward_residual_since_sep25', count(*)::text, round(sum(residual_cents)/100.0,2)::text FROM incentive_balance_observations WHERE at > '2026-09-25' AND residual_cents > 0 AND NOT coalesce(presumed_transfer,false)
